name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: Central sector scheme providing holistic end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools across 18 traditional trades.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
target_beneficiaries: Traditional artisans and craftspeople engaged in one of 18 notified family-based trades (carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, sculptors, cobblers, masons, etc.) aged 18 years and above
benefits: Recognition as Vishwakarma with ID card and certificate, basic skill training (5-7 days) with Rs. 500/day stipend, modern toolkit incentive of Rs. 15,000 via e-RUPI, collateral-free credit up to Rs. 3,00,000 (Tranche 1: Rs. 1 lakh, Tranche 2: Rs. 2 lakh) at 5% concessional interest rate, and digital transaction incentives.

source_evidence.statement: Administered jointly by the Ministry of MSME, Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, and Ministry of Finance.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

source_evidence.statement: Central sector scheme covering traditional artisans across all rural and urban areas of India.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

source_evidence.statement: Artisans and craftspeople self-employed in one of the 18 specified trades on self-employment basis.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

source_evidence.statement: Vishwakarma ID, basic and advanced skill training, Rs. 15,000 toolkit voucher, and collateral-free enterprise credit up to Rs. 3 lakh at 5% interest.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

source_evidence.statement: Online registration portal hosted at pmvishwakarma.gov.in.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

source_evidence.statement: Over 20 lakh successful applications verified through 3-tier Gram Panchayat/ULB verification process.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Beneficiary must not have availed loans under PMEGP, PM SVANidhi or Mudra in past 5 years and must not be a government employee or family member.

required_documents.title: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: UIDAI identity proof with biometric authentication.

required_documents.title: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Account Passbook
required_documents.description: Active bank account for receiving skill stipend and toolkit voucher.

required_documents.title: Trade Self-Declaration
required_documents.description: Declaration of active engagement in one of the 18 notified artisan trades.
required_documents.issuing_authority: Applicant / Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body
